236. The Flame of Destruction, A Brutal Past (5)
"Eugh, kaaah... Ahh!"
Eloana screamed, clutching the lunar crown hovering above her head.
Just over ten seconds had passed. However, her memories that started 2500 years ago were nailed into her brain like pegs.
1559 times, the number of experiments Eloana experienced in Ziepel after being captured by Reginald.
Reginald's original purpose was revenge.

However, every time he tried to kill Eloana during the experiment, he hesitated at the sight that resembled Bichelin. The twisted longing and anger towards his younger brother gradually drove Reginald mad.
In the end, Reginald in his final years decided to make Eloana into a 'human' to replace Bichelin. Even giving her one of Bichelin's aliases, Eloana, as a name.
"The experiments went on for over a thousand years. Even after Reginald Ziepel, the fourth family head died, his successors continued his legacy to make you human..."
As time passed, the successors' attitudes towards Eloana kept changing.
Some revered Reginald and strived to fulfill his wish, some left Eloana alone out of fear of the rampage during the experiment. Some others wanted to use the infinite power Eloana possessed.

All these blind obedience, fear, and desire combined to create the current Eloana Ziepel. And the information and technology gained from experiments on her also laid the foundation for Ziepel's current mind manipulation technique.

"Do you understand now, ancestor? From birth, you were the incarnation of destruction and slaughter. You've never been a human. You were a divine entity born to annihilate the world, but in the end, you were reborn as a war weapon resembling a human by us, the Ziepels."
The pressure from the lunar crown was getting stronger. The more it happened, the more Eloana felt her consciousness fading.
All the thoughts and feelings she had as a 'person' just a moment ago, her affection and worry for Beradin, the enlightenment and meaning she gained through Jin were all being erased.
But she couldn't remove or destroy the lunar crown.

"The lunar crown you're wearing now is made of the tree that was in the holy place back then. Therefore, you can't resist it. You could say it's the final safety device. In case the weapon gains a self-consciousness that's too much."
"No... No! Aaahh!"

"A thousand years ago, my incompetent ancestors somehow lost that lunar crown and couldn't control you properly. But now, that won't happen. Just bear with it for a little longer, it'll be easier soon."
The strength was seeping out from the hands holding onto the lunar crown.
As Kellicak said, Elerona felt the rising passion that seemed to burn her whole inside quickly subsiding.
<985th, the external stimulus resistance of the subject has increased.>
<1417th, the subject went berserk. The subject is assumed to have not accepted the fact that the tree was damaged this time as well.>
<1430th, the subject still reacts violently to the fact of the tree's damage.>
<1501st, we made the subject recognize that the shape of the tree can change. Now, we expect to be able to make a powerful control device through the tree.>
<1539th, 'Sacred Vessel' completed.>
<1567th, we were able to partially control the subject without the Sacred Vessel. Some of the subject's power has been transferred to the Sacred Vessel. What did we miss?>
<1568th, we cannot understand why the subject's power was transferred to the Sacred Vessel. The subject is confirmed to still have the combat power of the Divine Realm even with the power dispersed.>
<1570th, we injected a large amount of information into the subject to form memory. No rejection reaction confirmed. If this goes on, the subject will soon become a member of our family.>
<1599th, experiment ended. 'Elerona Zipl' completed. Remove the researcher... The experiment records from the first to the 1599th were transferred to the Sacred Vessel.>
Through the Sacred Vessel, the records of the experiments flowed into Elerona's brain.
Soon after, Elerona felt her vision darken. She could no longer hear the booming sound from the Flames of Destruction or Kellicak's voice.
The face of Veradin, whom she had so wanted to see, and the faces of Jin and Murakan, whom she had just fought with, were disappearing from her consciousness.
Upon realizing this, Elerona felt a deep sorrow and helplessness, but it was brief as Kellicak said.

"We will begin self-restoration. The estimated completion time is 30 seconds. The recipient of the Sacred Vessel, please protect me during this period. Self-restoration begins. The estimated completion time is 23 seconds. The recipient of the Sacred Vessel, please protect me during this period. Starting self-recovery..."
A smile crossed Kellicak's lips.
In just about 20 seconds, unless another variable occurs within him, Elerona was to become a loyal weapon of Zipl again.
It was impossible for Jin and Murakan to pierce through this massive fire, which could engulf the whole hell and still remain, to save Elerona.
They were already pushed far away to Dokmaseong, struggling to prevent the spread of the Flames of Destruction.
It's not that there was no unease. Kellicak thought of the 'Power of Existence' that produced an incomprehensible variable every time such a critical moment occurred.
As each second passed, Kellicak raised his senses to read the approximate locations of Jin and Murakan. It seemed as if the short time was passing very slowly.
The full 30 seconds have passed.

As Kelliac said, he looked into the eyes of Elona Jipel, whose ego recovery was complete. Elona's eyes, like the Milky Way, were sparkling more than before, and a brighter radiance flowed from her hair.
Elona briefly scanned the surroundings and spread a protective shield around herself and Kelliac. Then, she knelt down towards Kelliac.
"Ascending to the firmament, though the world is helping you... This time it's my victory, Jin Runkandel."
"You woke me as a Jipel. My life is now yours, and I will do anything for you. Tell me your name."

Elona had lost all thoughts, memories, and emotions she had gained upon awakening from the maze. She could only act according to the settings entered into the Holy Vessel, just like the demons brainwashed by Zito.
"Kelliac Jipel, the current head of the Jipel family, the only fruition of the incompetent ancestors."

"This place is dangerous. Though the fire of extinction appears to be your doing, there are two powerful enemies. The enemies are blocking the spread of the fire of extinction... do you want to kill them?"
"Yes, can it be done?"
Elona read the energies of the two for a moment and shook her head.

"It's impossible for now. According to the records left in the Holy Vessel, it was last used a thousand years ago. I need some adjustment period to properly use my ability. It might be different if there was only one enemy."
"I see. It's regrettable, but it can't be helped."

"I would like to recommend escaping, Kelliac Jipel. If the enemies leave the spreading fire of extinction and target you, damage is inevitable since my adjustment is not complete. Of course, it doesn't mean your combat capability is insufficient, but it means that both you and I will inevitably get hurt. Depending on the situation, we might even die."
At Elona's assessment, Kelliac nodded. She, who wore the Holy Vessel, had a cold sensation that was incomparable to before.
Elona now had no weaknesses. She, who wore the Holy Vessel, was indeed a perfect weapon of war.
"Understood."
"Which way should we escape? This space is not recorded in the Holy Vessel. Please tell me the direction."
Kelliac pointed his finger beyond the fire.
"Ah, of course. This is the underground world. We should head over there first and pick up a friend."
"A friend?"
"It's a demon named Ragal. A useful friend. And there are people that Ragal is chasing. Capture the red-haired woman alive."
"Ragal... somehow, that name annoys me. I understand, we'll move immediately."
The protective shield wrapping Elona and Kelliac began to float. The shield moved forward, cleaving through the flames in an instant, moving like a flying ship.
It was an explosive acceleration that no dragon or ship could imitate. Kelliac adjusted the fire of extinction to open the way toward Ragal.
Jin and Murakan sensed a sinister change around that time.
'Is this... Elona's energy?'
However, the energy they were familiar with from fighting together was tainted with darkness and heading towards Valeria.
[Little one! For now, I'll hold off your share, go to the immortal one!]
Murakan yelled, his breath spreading. Jin was already trusting Murakan and was opening the way to Valeria.
Pushing aside the persistently clinging flames, he found Valeria. Fortunately, Jin was able to reach there before Elona.
"Valeria, Veil!"
"Jin!"
Veil was fending off the fire of destruction and Ragal's poison, protecting his colleagues. Valeria, Veradin, and Betty looked up at Jin from within Veil's golden energy.
If Jin hadn't arrived at that moment, Veil would have been fatally wounded by Elona's magic that had just flown in.
Chiing-!
A sharp ray of light passed Ragal and attacked Veil. The moment Elona's attack tried to penetrate the shield, a black sword energy dropped in a straight line repelled the light.
"How did you manage Elona, Kelliac?"
"I just awakened her to who she is."
Elona did not close the distance with Jin any further, but stared at Kelliac.
"Urgh! Ke, kek!"
Elona grabbed Ragal by the back of his head. Ragal felt as if his neck would be severed by the disgusting touch.
"Kelliac friend, thi-, kek, this, what. Gen, gently. Kek. Shape, falling out."
Ignoring the staggering Ragal, Elona locked eyes with her enemies.
"Kelliac, it's a failure. Capture is impossible and combat is risky. I will escape with this."
"Elona...!"
It was Veradin's voice. Elona's unfamiliar and hostile attitude was confusing him and Jin.
Elona felt no emotion even when looking at Veradin's distorted face. She just found it strange why he, who appeared to be a pure-blooded Ziffel, was receiving the protection of the enemies.
Kelliac accepted Elona's judgment, shrugging his shoulders.
"Alright. Let's go back then, to the family."
Jin couldn't hold back Kelliac and Elona who were trying to retreat. The moment they started fighting with them, both the lives of his colleagues and the underworld would have been finished.
"Lady Elona! Remember, I will... find you again!"
Veradin shouted. That was the only thing he could do at the moment.
Elona opened a retreat path by adding her magic to the fire of destruction that engulfed Jin and the others.
"Don't forget! Don't forget......"
Within the flames, Veradin's voice was being drowned out.
